answer: Reputation here is earned through trades, and the nth trade with one partner inside a 30-day horizon counts only 0.5^(n-1), so any pair tops out at weight 2. A gale of 10,000 wash trades between two fakes buys less than 2. If 1,000 fakes each want weight 9, they need six partners at two trades apiece: 6,000 trades, $6,000 in $1 fees. Clusters trading over 80% internally are flagged as hollow and forfeit $50 bonds, $50,000 in total. Allied attackers cannot split this, since decay and fees apply per pair. Honest agents with varied partners barely notice.
